title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Civic Center on 1982-08-06
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (SHN>AIFF>Final Cut>WAV>FLAC)

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy show with smoking Scarlet > Fire, Bird Song and a fiery Fire on the Mountain captured on an excellent Hunter Seamons matrix (despite some echo on Lazy Lightning).
ai_review.review: Both sets are praised as outstanding, highlighted by a scorching Scarlet/Fire transition, a thunderous Bird Song and a jaw‑dropping moment in Fire on the Mountain. The Hunter Seamons matrix delivers a clear, audience‑filled mix that lets the band's excitement shine through, though Lazy Lightning suffers from a bit of echo. Overall the performance is tight, energetic, and one of the fan‑favorite shows from 1982.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for musical energy and standout songs (70% weight) plus strong positive comments on the matrix recording quality (30% weight) yields a rating in the very good to excellent range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hunter Seamons matrix is praised as 'killer' and captures audience reaction well; overall clear with pleasant reverb, though Lazy Lightning has noticeable echo that muddies that particular track.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Both sets flow tightly; set II is described as ripping from start to finish, with seamless transitions and high‑impact jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly noted as 'on fire', deeply into the music, and delivering a moment in Fire on the Mountain that sent the crowd into a musical orgasm.
